name: data-grid
title: Data grid
description: Table in grid mode, for a price list or a bulk edit: a role="grid" whose cells you walk with the arrow keys (one cell holds focus, a ring inside it), edit where they stand (Field, NumberField or Select by the column's kind; check cells toggle) with onCellCommit that saves and rolls back on a rejection, select as a range (Shift, a drag, ⌘A) and copy, cut, paste or clear as tab-separated text; columns reorder by a grip on Sortable's lift. Everything else is Table's: kinds, sort, selection, totals, groups, sizing.
docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/data-grid.md. SwiftUI: MetalDataGrid in the MetalUI Swift package.
